title: Apple Pay Is Finally in India… But There's a Catch
description:
Apple Pay is now live in India, starting with Axis Bank Visa and Mastercard credit cards only.
No UPI and no RuPay at launch, and HDFC, ICICI and SBI Card aren't on board yet.
